name: analytics
description: Stand-in for benchmarks/workloads/analytics.json (absent from the workspace): analytical queries over the pqgen datasets, loaded as CSV with their schemas under their file base names.

queries.name: q01_filter_count
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE amount > 1000 AND status = 'approved'

queries.name: q02_group_low
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS s, AVG(fee) AS f, MIN(ts) AS t0, MAX(ts) AS t1 FROM transactions GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: q03_group_high
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS s FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id

queries.name: q04_join_agg
queries.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(t.amount) AS s FROM transactions t JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

queries.name: q05_topn
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount FROM transactions WHERE status = 'approved' ORDER BY amount DESC, tx_id LIMIT 10

queries.name: q06_float_agg
queries.sql: SELECT sensor_id % 100 AS s, MIN(temperature) AS lo, MAX(temperature) AS hi, AVG(humidity) AS h, SUM(pressure) AS p FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY sensor_id % 100 ORDER BY s

queries.name: q07_join3
queries.sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS lines, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC

queries.name: q08_count_distinct
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) AS m FROM transactions

queries.name: q09_project
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount * 2 AS a2, fee + amount AS t FROM transactions WHERE bucket < 50

queries.name: q10_nulls
queries.sql: SELECT b60, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(n50) AS c50, SUM(n90) AS s90, AVG(f95) AS a95, MAX(s70) AS m FROM nulls_heavy GROUP BY b60

queries.name: q11_case_expr
queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN amount > 500 THEN 'big' WHEN amount > 50 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'small' END AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_fraud THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS f FROM transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

queries.name: q12_sort_offset
queries.sql: SELECT id, dup_key, str_key FROM sort_keys ORDER BY dup_key, str_key, id LIMIT 20 OFFSET 1000

queries.name: q13_left_join
queries.sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(i.order_id) AS lines FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.quantity > 8 GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

queries.name: q14_distinct
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT currency, category, status FROM transactions

queries.name: q15_comma_join
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o, customers c WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND c.segment = 'enterprise'

queries.name: q16_full_sort
queries.sql: SELECT id, dup_key, float_key FROM sort_keys ORDER BY dup_key, float_key DESC, id

queries.name: q17_scan_filter
queries.sql: SELECT tx_id, amount, category FROM transactions WHERE category LIKE '%e%' AND fee < 5

queries.name: q18_global_agg
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MIN(ts), MAX(bucket), COUNT(fee) FROM transactions

queries.name: q19_range_filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(unit_price), MAX(discount) FROM order_items WHERE quantity BETWEEN 3 AND 5 AND product_id < 5000

queries.name: q20_in_list
queries.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions WHERE bucket IN (1, 7, 42, 99, 500) GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

queries.name: q21_date_range
queries.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(item_count) AS s FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2024-04-01' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

queries.name: q22_null_filter
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(n90), MIN(d99) FROM nulls_heavy WHERE n50 IS NOT NULL AND n90 > 100

queries.name: q23_float_minmax
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(temperature), MAX(temperature), MIN(pressure), MAX(humidity) FROM sensor_readings

queries.name: q24_monthly
queries.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS s FROM transactions WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) ORDER BY m

queries.name: q25_top_customers
queries.sql: SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM transactions GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY total DESC, customer_id LIMIT 20

queries.name: q26_in_subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM transactions WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE segment = 'enterprise' AND is_active)

queries.name: q27_cte_join
queries.sql: WITH ot AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS total FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(ot.total) AS avg_total, MAX(ot.total) AS max_total FROM orders o JOIN ot ON ot.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

queries.name: q28_country_revenue
queries.sql: SELECT c.country, YEAR(o.order_date) AS y, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country, YEAR(o.order_date) ORDER BY c.country, y

queries.name: q29_string_funcs
queries.sql: SELECT UPPER(SUBSTR(brand, 1, 3)) AS b, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(weight_kg) AS w FROM products WHERE LENGTH(name) > 10 GROUP BY UPPER(SUBSTR(brand, 1, 3)) ORDER BY n DESC, b LIMIT 10

queries.name: q30_sensor_hourly
queries.sql: SELECT HOUR(ts) AS h, status, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(temperature) AS t FROM sensor_readings WHERE temperature > 20.0 GROUP BY HOUR(ts), status ORDER BY h, status

queries.name: q31_scalar_subquery
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) * 3 FROM transactions)

queries.name: q32_derived_table
queries.sql: SELECT n, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) d GROUP BY n ORDER BY n
